as_told.title: Minot AFB bomber encounters a saucer
as_told.place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

plain: In 1968, at Minot Air Force Base, a US military base in North Dakota, an unknown object was reportedly caught on radar, and Michels says physicists have since gone over that radar record. He brings it up in a debate with a skeptic and names the physicist Kevin Knuth as one of the people who reviewed it. He tells it as a case that rests on more than eyewitness accounts. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, speaking without naming a source, tells the same base's story differently: a bomber, which he calls a B-2, met a saucer that flew around it. He gives no year and says nothing about the radar or Knuth.
